text: Presentation to provide an update on the Our Plan Toronto: Chapter One Review. The Manager of the Official Plan and Legislation team, will provide an overview of the process to date, as well as an outline of the draft, including Indigenous Planning Perspectives, our 2051 vision statement, priorities, principles, and next steps. This presentation is part of the final phase of engagement taking place in the first quarter (Q1) of 2024. The final report will be taken to the April Planning and Housing Committee.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
